description: Chart type. Put it in type, never in mark (mark is an options object). 'line': Lines over a continuous x (usually time). One or more y fields. Replaces LineChart. 'bar': Bars per category (x). Grouped or stacked; vertical or horizontal.
label: Type

description: Optional stable id (used for keys, events, test hooks).
label: Id

description: Visible chart title; also the accessible name.
label: Title

description: Visible secondary line under the title.
label: Subtitle

description: Small label above the value.
label: Label

description: Primary figure, drawn in the chart.
label: Value

description: Secondary comparison figure, in the muted colour.
label: Compare

description: Change badge, drawn as a pill.
label: Delta

description: Pill colour. positive uses the positive token, negative the negative token.
label: Tone

description: Horizontal position: time or category. For donut, the slice category. For heatmap calendar, the date. For bar with mark.orientation 'horizontal', it is still the category (drawn vertically).
label: X field

description: Measurement type of the field. Inferred from data if omitted: numbers→quantitative, ISO date strings/epoch ms on x→temporal, other strings→nominal.
label: Type

description: Human-readable name used in axes, legend and tooltip. Defaults to the field name.
label: Title

description: How values are displayed in axes, tooltips and labels. A preset string, or an object for fine control. Formatting uses Intl with the spec 'locale'.
label: Format

description: Fixed number of fraction digits.
label: Decimals

description: ISO 4217 code when style is 'currency'.
label: Currency

description: Text placed before the value.
label: Prefix

description: Text placed after the value, e.g. ' req/s'.
label: Suffix

description: Always show + for positive numbers (useful for deltas).
label: Signed

description: d3-style format: .2f, ,.0f, $,.0f, .1%, .2e, +.1f, or s. A string format such as ".2f" is repaired to this.
label: Specifier

description: Scale type. Inferred from field type: quantitative→linear, temporal→time, nominal/ordinal→band. symlog is a signed log that passes through zero.
label: Type

description: Explicit [min, max] for continuous scales, or the ordered list of categories for band/point scales. Use null for one side to keep it automatic.
label: Domain

description: Force the scale to include zero. Default true for bar/area, false for line/scatter.

description: Round the domain to tidy tick values. Default true.
label: Nice

description: Flip the direction of the scale.
label: Reverse

description: Extra room past the data, as a fraction of the span. A number pads both ends. An object pads one end. 0.08 is eight percent. An explicit domain end stays as set.

description: Fraction of the span added below the data.
label: Min

description: Fraction of the span added above the data.

description: Draw values outside an explicit scale.domain at the domain edge.

description: Colour the kpi surface from the value. The last step at or below metric.value wins. Applies to: kpi.

label: Curve

description: Downsample the path when a series is longer than twice the plot width in pixels. 'auto' and 'minmax' keep the minimum and maximum original point in each pixel bucket (spikes stay).

description: Show point markers on lines. Applies to: line, combo.
label: Points

description: Ranked-row track. bar is a short rounded bar. row is a full-height wash behind the label, width proportional to the value, with the count on the right. Applies to: bar-list.

description: Point radius in px. Applies to: line, stacked-area, combo, scatter, errorbar, strip.
label: Point Size

description: Point marker. circle, square, diamond, triangle, cross, or none. A y series may override it. Applies to: line, stacked-area, scatter, combo. Drawn on createRenderer([line]).

description: Filled or hollow markers. Applies to: line, stacked-area, scatter, combo.
label: Point Fill

description: Fill under every line. Applies to: line, sparkline.
label: Area

description: Area/bar fill opacity, 0–1. Applies to: line, stacked-area, combo, mini-area, bar, streamgraph. A streamgraph defaults to 0.22.

description: Fade area fills toward the baseline. Applies to: line, stacked-area, mini-area, sparkline.

description: Line width in px. Applies to: line, stacked-area, combo, sparkline, mini-area, spike, progress-ring, gauge (arc width), streamgraph.

description: Soft glow behind the line. A blurred understroke and one filter, emitted only when true, on Soft and on midnight. Applies to: line, sparkline, combo.

description: Draw through missing values instead of leaving gaps. Applies to: line, stacked-area, combo, sparkline, mini-area, streamgraph.
label: Connect Nulls

description: Stacking for multiple series. 'percent' normalises each x to 100%. Applies to: bar, stacked-area (default 'stack'), combo bars, radial-bar, rose. On a polar chart, none groups the sectors and stack or percent runs outward from the hole.

description: Streamgraph baseline. wiggle minimizes layer-to-layer movement and is the default. center, also called silhouette, centers each column on zero. zero stacks on the axis. expand draws shares that sum to 1. One series repairs to zero.
label: Stream Offset

description: Streamgraph layer order. Omitted means inside-out when the baseline is wiggle, and first-seen order otherwise. inside-out puts the smallest series in the middle. ascending and descending sort by the series sum.
label: Order

description: Bar direction. vertical is the bar default. Strip treats an omission as horizontal: categories run down the y axis and the numeric axis is x. Set vertical to swap them.
label: Orientation

description: Rounded corners in px. Applies to: bar, donut, pie, heatmap, radial-bar, rose. A radial bar rounds the outer end.

description: Spacing between bars/cells as a 0–1 fraction of the band. Applies to: bar, combo, heatmap, candlestick, radial-bar, rose. On a grouped polar chart it is the share of the category left between series.
label: Gap

description: Pixel gap between stacked segments. Applies to: bar, stacked-area, combo.
label: Stack Gap

description: Which bar corners round. outer rounds the end away from the baseline. all rounds every corner. Applies to: bar.
label: Radius Ends

description: Dash the last segment only. The area still covers the whole series, including that segment. Applies to: line, stacked-area, combo.
label: Partial

description: Fill opacity of the last area segment. The earlier area keeps mark.fillOpacity. Applies to: line, stacked-area, combo.
label: Partial Opacity

description: Draw value labels on the marks. Applies to: bar, donut, pie, line, stacked-area, scatter, radial-bar, rose, streamgraph. A streamgraph label is the series name at the thickest part of the layer.

description: Where the value label sits. top, bottom, left, right, and center suit line, area, and scatter. inside and outside suit bar, donut, and pie. Outside pie and donut labels draw leader lines. Setting it turns labels on.

description: Format preset for data labels. Falls back to the series format, then a plain number. Setting it turns labels on. Applies to: bar, donut, pie, line, stacked-area, scatter, combo.

label: Label Ends

description: Label the total of a stacked bar or stacked area. On a bar this also stacks the series. Applies to: bar, stacked-area.
label: Stack Total

description: Hole size as a 0–0.95 fraction of the radius. Donut defaults to 0.6. Pie defaults to 0. Sunburst uses 0.28 when this is omitted. Radial-bar defaults to 0.34. Rose defaults to 0. Above 0.85 on a polar chart warns CK3075.
label: Inner Radius

description: How many levels to draw under the root. Deeper nodes fold into that level. Default 8. Applies to: treemap, sunburst.
label: Depth

description: Gap between slices in degrees. Donut defaults to 2. Pie defaults to 0. Radial-bar defaults to 2. Rose defaults to 1.2. Above 8 degrees on a polar chart warns CK3076. Applies to: donut, pie, radial-bar, rose.
label: Pad Angle

description: Tick drawn across each group. median is the default. mean is the arithmetic mean. none draws no tick. A strip where every group has one point hides the tick. Applies to: strip.
label: Summary

description: Bar behind the dots. none draws none. range runs from the minimum to the maximum. iqr runs from the first quartile to the third. A group with fewer than 3 points draws no band. Applies to: strip.
label: Band

description: Spread dots that share a position. auto offsets a dot only when another dot in the group is within one diameter. none never offsets. A number is the maximum offset in px and moves every dot.
label: Jitter

description: Group value to draw in accent. Every other group uses muted. The summary tick stays ink. Applies to: strip.
label: Highlight

description: Slice order. none keeps data order and pins an Other bucket last. asc and desc sort by value, including Other.
label: Sort

description: Group small slices into one Other slice. A number is the fraction. Applies to: donut, pie.
label: Other

description: Name of the folded slice. Default Other.
label: Label

description: Pull slices out from the centre, in px. With mark.explode, only those slices move. Otherwise every slice moves. Applies to: donut, pie.
label: Offset

description: Slice names to offset. Uses mark.offset, or 12px when offset is omitted. Applies to: donut, pie.
label: Explode

description: Series colours for this chart, in order. Overrides the theme palette. Omit it to keep the theme tokens. Applies to: line, bar, scatter, combo, stacked-area, donut, pie.
label: Palette

description: Conditional colours. First match wins and overrides the series or category colour. A bar rule's legend swatch is the bar fill. A rule colour within CIE76 delta-E 25 of a series colour in the same theme shifts to a distinct shade.

description: Legend name for values that match no colour rule, such as Normal. The series entry is renamed to the series name plus this label, for example Reading: Normal, and it is a square when those values are bars. Omit it to keep the series name.

description: Mark opacity 0–1. Applies to: scatter, spike.
label: Opacity

label: End Angle

description: Value spikes rise from. Applies to: spike.
label: Baseline

label: Shape

description: Histogram bin rule. count uses mark.bins. width uses mark.binWidth. sturges, sqrt, and fd choose a count from the data. Applies to: histogram.

description: Draw the bin count at the top right of the plot, clear of the y ticks. Omit it and that corner stays empty. Applies to: histogram.

description: Domain of the density curve. pad extends the sample by 3 bandwidths. data clips to the sample. A pair is the domain. Applies to: density.

description: density integrates to 1. count multiplies by the sample size. Applies to: density.

description: 1 is the kernel curve. 2 is not available yet and is CK3109. Applies to: density.

description: Draw a tick for each raw sample on the baseline. Applies to: density.

description: Bad/down color. CSS value or var(--x).
label: Negative

description: CSS font-family. Omitted, or inherit, uses the page font. A list such as Georgia, serif sets --ck-font-family. At most 80 characters. No double quotes, <, >, ;, {, }, or backslash. Invalid values are CK3086.
label: Font Family

description: Base font size in px.
label: Font Size

description: Categorical series palette in order. CSS colors or var(--x). Default: var(--ck-series-1..12) falling back to the preset.
label: Series

description: Width in px, or 'auto' to fill the container and follow resizes.
label: Width

description: Height in px, or 'auto' to derive from width × aspectRatio or the container height.
label: Height

description: width / height, used when height is 'auto' (e.g. 1.777 for 16:9).
label: Aspect Ratio

description: Minimum height in px when responsive.
label: Min Height

description: Inner padding in px around the plot, a number or per-side object. Default: automatic from axis label sizes.
label: Padding

description: Top padding in px.
label: Top

description: Right padding in px.
label: Right

description: Bottom padding in px.
label: Bottom

description: Left padding in px.
label: Left

description: rtl mirrors a categorical x axis, moves the y axis to the right, and right-aligns the title. The SVG sets dir=rtl. Default ltr.
label: Direction

description: Coordinate system. polar is angle and radius, and it is how radial-bar and rose draw. Setting polar on bar repairs the type to radial-bar. On pie or donut it repairs to rose. On any other type the patch removes it (CK3077).
label: Coordinate

description: Column that splits the data. A name that is not a field warns CK3041. Omitting it warns CK3040.
label: Field

description: Panels across. 1 to 12. Outside that range warns CK3042 and the patch clamps it. Omit to choose from the category count.
label: Columns

description: Panels down. 1 to 12. Outside that range warns CK3043 and the patch clamps it.
label: Rows

description: Flow extra categories onto new rows. false keeps the grid and warns CK3049 when categories do not fit.
label: Wrap

description: shared (default) locks every panel to one nice y domain that includes the data max. Y labels and the y title sit on the outer column only, and x labels and the x title sit on the bottom row.
label: Scales

description: shared (default) draws one legend under the grid. each repeats the legend in every panel.
label: Legend

description: Wrap views into this many columns, 2 to 4. A view may set span to the number of columns it covers, so one wide chart can sit above two narrower ones. Omit to use direction.
label: Columns

description: vertical stacks the views. horizontal places them in a row. Ignored when columns is set.
label: Direction

description: Space between views, in px. Default 16.
label: Gap

description: Chart specs. A view with no type warns CK3045. An empty list warns CK3044.
label: Views

description: The first rule whose width matches size.width, or the container width when width is auto, overrides the layout. A non-positive maxWidth warns CK3046. columns or rows without a facet field warns CK3047.
label: Breakpoints

description: Highlight hovered marks and drive the tooltip.
label: Hover

description: Click selection. 'point' or 'series'. Shift, Ctrl, or Meta adds another. Escape or a background click clears. Selected marks use --ck-selected; others use --ck-dim. Emits pointclick or seriesclick, and selectionchange.
label: Select

description: Wheel/pinch zoom. Default 'x' for candlestick, otherwise 'none'.
label: Zoom

description: Drag to pan when zoomed.
label: Pan

description: Drag to select a range, emitted as 'rangechange'.
label: Brush

description: Initially visible x range [from, to] in data units (zoomable charts).
label: Initial Range

description: Formats offered by the export menu. The SVG records them as data-ck-export. The menu loads only when this list is set. toPNG, toSVG, and toCSV are @chartkitdev/core/export.
label: Export

description: Overview sparkline and range slider under the chart. true, or an object with height. The slider loads with the interaction extras. The server SVG records data-ck-nav and does not include the control.
label: Show

description: Overview height in px. 28 to 96. A value outside that range warns CK3035 and the patch clamps it.
label: Height

description: Group id. Charts with the same id share the crosshair, tooltip, and x window, matched on the x value. An empty string warns CK3036.
label: Sync

description: Data field that names the child. Default: encoding.x. A name that is not a field warns CK3039.
label: Key

description: Child specs keyed by category. Each child needs a type. An empty map warns CK3037. A child with no type warns CK3038.
label: Children

description: Entry/update animation. Always disabled when the user prefers reduced motion.
label: On

description: Milliseconds.
label: Duration

description: Easing curve.
label: Easing

description: BETA. The API may change. How an update moves marks from the previous spec. Omitted and "none" are off, including every existing spec. "auto" is 320ms ease-out (cubic-bezier(0, 0, 0.58, 1)).
label: Motion

description: Milliseconds. Clamped to 0–800. 0 is off. Omitted means 320.
label: Duration

description: How the marks are drawn. svg is the default and what render() always returns, including on the server, with the marks included.
label: Render

description: BCP 47 locale for number/date formatting. Default: the host's locale.
label: Locale

description: IANA time zone for temporal axes, ticks, and tooltips. Omitted means UTC, so a server render and the client label the same instant the same way.
label: Timezone

description: Field to sort by.
label: Field

description: Sort by the first y value. Used for bars.
label: By

description: Sort direction. Default ascending.
label: Order

description: Row steps applied before sort: filter, a rolling window, or an aggregate.
label: Transform

description: Short text alternative with the key insight, e.g. 'Revenue rose 18% from Jan to Jun 2026, peaking in May.'
label: Alt

description: Longer description (methodology, caveats). Exposed via aria-describedby.
label: Description

description: Arrow-key navigation between points with announcements. Off unless set, because turning it on loads the interaction runtime.
label: Keyboard

description: Render a visually hidden data table for screen readers. Off unless set, because turning it on loads the interaction runtime.
label: Data Table
